original_document.title: World Cup Home Internet beIN STREAM promo - Telecom Egypt

chunks.text: World Cup Home Internet beIN STREAM promo: Enjoy 50% discount on your beIN STREAM World Cup bundle. You get a free beIN STREAM device exclusively from WE, along with 100 GB and a complimentary 3-month subscription to beIN SPORTS channels. Eligible packages for discounts: - Super 250,300,400,500,750 GB packages - Mega 250,500,750 GB packages - Ultra 250,500,750 packages Price after discount: 4300 EGP Offer: Free beIN STREAM device, Free 100GB, 3-month subscription to beIN SPORTS channels. - Super 1500 GB package - Mega 1500 GB package - Max 1500 GB package - Max Plus 1500 GB package Price after discount: 4000 EGP

Terms & Conditions: - beIN STREAM promo available for subscription on WE Space plans. - World Cup package price for Super 50,150,200 GB packages is 4800 EGP. - Customer will get 100 GBs as a gift upon subscription for one time when he receives the device on his Home Internet number valid for 30 days. - Customers can subscribe through WE branches or by contacting customer service 111. - Customers can request home delivery of the beIN STREAM device for a shipping charge of 50 EGP, excluding VAT. - All prices are excluding VAT.
